知.def: to know, to perceive, to comprehend

ety.hint: mouth

origin.says: Oracle-bone forms join an adult, a mouth and a child: knowledge passed on by word of mouth. The adult later became 矢 (arrow), read as the sound, and the child dropped out, leaving 矢 + 口 (mouth).

知.name: know

ety.hint: Three leaves on a branch

origin.says: One reading: a branch with new leaves, the old form of 葉 (leaf) without the tree; each year's leaves led to 'generation', then 'era' and 'world'. Another reading: three 十 (ten), thirty years for a generation.

ety.hint: A right hand, representing a pair; compare 左

origin.says: A drawing of a right hand, the original form of 右 (right). It was borrowed for the word 'again, also'.

又.name: again
又.in: 对最度受变爱报反权技服取难友支欢观戏版察择仅坚双释紧努趣饭督板授怪摄漫慢鼓餐搜树侵泽译援汉聚圣鸡怒缓拔暖奴返歧艰叔滩擦渡

入.def: to enter, to come in; to join

ety.hint: An arrow indicating "enter"

origin.says: An arrowhead pointing inward, or an entrance; a sign for 'to enter'. Compare 人 (person), which it resembles.

入.name: enter

ety.hint: sunlight

origin.says: 景 (light, which also meant shadow) as the sound plus 彡 (lines of light and shape), added later to make a separate character for shadow and image.

信.def: to trust, to believe; letter, sign

origin.says: 亻 (person) + 言 (words): a person standing by their word, hence trust, true; later also a letter. One reading takes 人 as the sound part, another reads the two meanings together.

信.name: trust

origin.says: Simplified from 務: 敄 (strive, itself 矛 (spear) as sound plus 攵 (hit)) plus 力 (strength): working hard, hence affairs and duty. The simple form dropped 矛 and wrote 攵 as 夂.

ety.hint: Twenty 廿 people 又 meeting inside a building 广 to deliberate

origin.says: 又 (hand) for the meaning, the hand being an old measure of length, plus a sound part on top: 石 (stone) by one reading, a shortened 庶 (multitude) by another; it has worn into 广 + 廿. To measure, hence degree.

受.def: to receive, to get, to accept; to bear

ety.hint: Something 冖 passed from one hand 爫 to another 又

origin.says: A hand (爫) above and a hand (又) below passing something between them, first 舟 (boat), now shortened to 冖: to hand over and to receive.

受.name: receive

ety.hint: Harvesting 刂 grain 禾

origin.says: 禾 (grain) plus 刂 (knife): reaping grain with a blade. From the sharp blade came 'sharp', and from the harvest 'gain, profit'.

社.def: group, organization, society; a god of the soil

ety.hint: An earth 土 spirit 礻; 礻 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 示 (altar, god), now 礻, next to 土 (soil): the god of the soil and the community that worshipped it, hence society.

社.name: society

origin.says: 宀 (house) and 口 (mouth): a sound echoing in a room, first 'echo' (now 响). Borrowed for 'facing, towards'. The roof has become a slanting stroke over a frame, so the parts no longer show.

见.def: to see, to observe, to meet, to appear

ety.hint: Simplified form of 見; a man 儿 with the eye 目 emphasized

origin.says: Simplified from 見: a big eye 目 on top of a kneeling person, someone looking, 'to see'. The simplified form writes it in cursive style.

见.name: see
见.in: 现规觉视观览宽舰榄揽搅觅砚缆窥

总.def: to gather, to collect; overall, altogether

ety.hint: Many mouths 口 speaking with one mind 心

origin.says: Simplified from 總 (bind together): 糸 (thread) plus 悤 as the sound. The simplified form drops the thread and writes 悤 short, as 丷 over 口 over 心 (heart).

总.name: gather all

解.def: to explain; to loosen; to unfasten, to untie

ety.hint: To cut 刀 the horns 角 off of an ox 牛; 角 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 角 (horn) + 刀 (knife) + 牛 (ox): cutting the horns off an ox, butchering it; hence to separate, untie, and explain.

解.name: untie

ety.hint: A hand with the fingers splayed

origin.says: A picture of a hand with its five fingers spread.

手.name: hand
手.in: 拿掌撑摩拳擎攀挚掰摹

保.def: to safeguard, to protect, to defend, to care for

ety.hint: person

origin.says: A person 亻 (person) carrying a child on the back: to protect. The child and the carrying hands later turned into the shape of 呆 (dull).

保.name: safeguard

变.def: to change, to transform, to alter; rebel

origin.says: Simplified from 變: 䜌 (tangled threads) as the sound plus 攴 (a hand with a stick) for the action of changing. The simplification wrote the 䜌 part as 亦 (also) and the hand as 又 (hand).

变.name: change

ety.hint: script

origin.says: Simplified from 數: 婁 (Lou) as the sound plus 攵 (hand with stick) for the meaning, tapping things off: to count, number. 婁 is written 娄.

记.def: mark, sign; to note, to record

ety.hint: A private 己 note 讠; 己 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 言 (speech, words) for the meaning plus 己 (self) as the sound: putting words down, to record. Simplified from 記, with 言 written 讠.

记.name: record

ety.hint: A bird settling into its nest, representing sunset; compare 東

origin.says: Early forms seem to draw a bird's nest or a woven basket; the word west was borrowed for its sound. An old explanation says birds go to their nests when the sun sets in the west; the picture itself is disputed.

ety.hint: A bird alighting on the ground 土

origin.says: Draws an arrow that has come down and stuck in the ground line: it has reached its spot, hence to arrive, and then 'to the utmost'.

持.def: to hold, to support, to sustain

ety.hint: hand

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 寺 as the sound: to hold. 寺 itself first meant 'hold'; the hand was added after 寺 came to mean 'temple'.

持.name: hold

据.def: to possess, to occupy; position; base

ety.hint: hand

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus a sound part: to grip, hold onto, occupy; then 'according to'. Simplified from 據, with the sound part 豦 replaced by 居 (reside).

据.name: evidence

ety.hint: Two fish 冉 caught on a line 一

origin.says: Origin unclear: one reading sees a frame of crossed timbers with an extra stroke for 'one more'; another sees 二 (two) inside, for a second time: again.

ety.hint: Speech 讠 that explains the logic 仑; 仑 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 侖 (orderly arrangement) as the sound: talking things through in order, to discuss. Simplified from 論 (讠 for 言, 仑 for 侖).

司.def: to take charge of, to control, to manage; officer

ety.hint: A person speaking orders 口 and raising their arm

origin.says: A mouth 口 (mouth) beside a hooked shape, perhaps a hand or a scepter: giving orders, to be in charge, to manage. It was once interchangeable with its mirror image 后 (queen); what the hook drew is not settled.

司.name: in charge

常.def: common, general, normal; always, frequently, regularly

ety.hint: cloth

origin.says: 尚 (esteem) as the sound plus 巾 (cloth) for the meaning: first a lower garment (now 裳). Borrowed for 'lasting, constant, often'.

常.name: often

ety.hint: A sprout growing in the ground, representing a budding talent

origin.says: A picture, read either as a sprout pushing up through the ground or as a sharp stake; 'talent' came by extension or by loan. In simplified writing it also replaces 纔 (only just).

ety.hint: A person bent over with long hair 匕 and a crutch; compare 耂

origin.says: A drawing of an old man with long hair and a bent back, leaning on a walking stick; the stick later became the 匕 shape at the bottom. It means old.

ety.hint: A craftsman using an awl 弋 and a measuring square 工

origin.says: 弋 (stake) as the sound plus 工 (work, tool) for the meaning: a standard way of working, a pattern, formula or style.

ety.hint: woman

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 台 (platform) as the sound: beginning, perhaps because life begins in a woman.
In oracle bones a man carrying a load on his shoulder, the first form of 荷 (carry). Later rebuilt as 亻 (person) plus 可 (can) as the sound, and borrowed for 'what, how'.

ety.hint: ox

origin.says: 牛 (ox) for the meaning plus 寺 as the sound: first a bull, a single male beast; hence 'single, special'. How the two senses connect is unclear.

治.def: to administer, to govern, to regulate

ety.hint: A structure 台 that directs the flow of water 氵

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 台 (platform) as the sound: first the name of a river. The meaning govern, manage is a borrowing for the sound, though taming water fits well as a memory aid.

治.name: govern

爱.def: to love, to like, to be fond of; love, affection

ety.hint: To bring a friend 友 into one's house 冖

origin.says: Simplified from 愛 (love), which was 心 (heart) with 旡 as the sound and a walking foot 夊 added below. The simplified form drops 心 and puts 友 (friend) at the bottom; the top is a worn-down 旡.

爱.name: love

界.def: boundary, limit; domain; society, the world

ety.hint: farm

origin.says: 田 (field) for the meaning plus 介 (go-between, in between) as the sound and hint: the line between fields, a boundary; then a realm, the world.

界.name: boundary

报.def: to announce, to report; newspaper; payback, revenge

ety.hint: A hand 扌 cuffing 又 a criminal 卩, representing sentencing

origin.says: From 報: 㚔 (handcuffs) plus 𠬝 (a hand forcing down a kneeling man): to sentence a criminal, later to repay, to report. The simplification put 扌 (hand) in place of 㚔.

报.name: report

站.def: stand, station; to halt, to stand; website; measure word for stands and stations

ety.hint: stand

origin.says: 立 (stand) for the meaning plus 占 (divine) as the sound: to stand, and a stopping place, a station. A late character of northern Chinese.

站.name: station

回.def: to return, to turn around; a time

ety.hint: Originally, a spiral signifying return

origin.says: Early forms draw a spiral or swirling water, something turning round on itself. From this came 'turn back, return'. The spiral became a box in a box (囗 + 口).

回.name: return

ety.hint: To look someone in the eye 目

origin.says: An eye 目 (eye) with a straight line above it, looking straight ahead; a corner stroke was added below later. Straight, direct, frank.

次.def: order, sequence; second, next; one after the other

ety.hint: A person 欠 yawning multiple times 冫

origin.says: A person with open mouth 欠 (yawn, breathe out) with marks of breath or spit, now 冫. It may first have meant to sigh; the meanings next, second, a time are later, likely borrowed.

次.name: next time

化.def: to change, to convert, to reform; -ize

origin.says: An upright person 亻 (person) beside an upside-down one 匕 (here a turned person): turning over, hence change and transform.

化.name: transform

组.def: to form, to assemble; section, department

ety.hint: thread

origin.says: Simplified from 組: 纟 (silk) for the meaning plus 且 (altar) as the sound: a woven silk band, then to group, to assemble. Only the silk part was simplified.

组.name: group

ety.hint: Rain 雨 needed for crops to grow

origin.says: Early forms show a person getting wet in the rain, the original of 濡 (soak). The person 天 (sky, here a standing man) turned into 而 (beard) in the Han period; need is a later use of the word.

完.def: to complete, to finish, to settle; whole

ety.hint: roof

origin.says: 宀 (roof, house) for the meaning plus 元 (first) as the sound: first "whole, intact" like a house with its roof on, then "to finish".

完.name: finish

决.def: to decide, to determine, to judge

origin.says: Simplified from 決: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 夬 (to split) as the sound: water bursting a dike, then 'cut off', 'decide'. The simplified form writes 冫 (ice) for 氵.

决.name: decide

ety.hint: Grains of sand; 小 provides the pronunciation and meaning

origin.says: Oracle forms are small dots like grains of sand, the same idea as 小 (small); a fourth stroke set it apart to mean 'few, little'.

少.name: few
少.in: 省沙秒妙吵炒劣抄鲨纱钞渺砂

接.def: to connect, to join; to receive, to meet, to answer the phone

ety.hint: hand

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 妾 (concubine) as the sound: to take with the hand, receive; to join, connect.

接.name: connect

候.def: to wait, to expect; to visit; to greet

ety.hint: person

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 矦 (target, old form of 侯) as the sound; the left stroke of 矦 became an upright line next to 亻. Watching and waiting; then season and time.

候.name: wait

件.def: item, matter; component, part; measure word for events

ety.hint: A man 亻 dividing up a cow 牛

origin.says: 亻 (person) plus 牛 (cow), perhaps a man cutting a cow into parts; why it means a piece or item is unclear.

件.name: item

ety.hint: Three  parallel lines; compare 一 (one) and 二 (two)

origin.says: Three horizontal strokes, a tally for three.

划.def: to row or paddle a boat; to scratch; to plan; profitable

origin.says: 戈 (dagger-axe) as the sound plus 刂 (knife) for the meaning: to scratch, to row. In simplification it also took over 劃 (to draw a line, to plan).

划.name: paddle

ety.hint: A name called out 口 to hail someone at night 夕

origin.says: 夕 (evening, a crescent moon) over 口 (mouth): in the dark people cannot see each other, so they call out their names. Another reading takes 夕 as a sound sign added to 口 (mouth).

选.def: to select, to elect, to choose; election

ety.hint: walk

origin.says: Simplified from 選: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 巽 as the sound; the simplified form replaces 巽 with 先 (first) as the sound: to choose, to pick out.

选.name: choose

第.def: sequence, number; grade, degree; particle prefacing an ordinal

ety.hint: Bamboo strips ⺮ arrayed in sequence; 弟 provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo, writing strips) for the meaning plus 弟 (younger brother, sequence) as the sound, with its top merged under the bamboo: order, rank, and the prefix for 'first, second…'.

第.name: rank order

品.def: article, good, product; commodity; quality, character

ety.hint: Something that everyone is talking 口 about

origin.says: Three 口 (mouths, objects): a variety of things together, articles, goods; hence kind, grade.

品.name: goods

打.def: to attack, to beat, to hit, to strike

ety.hint: hand

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 丁 (nail) as the sound; hammering a nail is a fitting hint. A fairly late character that grew into a very general verb: to hit, to do.

打.name: hit

ety.hint: hill

origin.says: Simplified from 際: 阝 (hill) for the meaning plus 祭 (sacrifice) as the sound, where two hills meet: border, juncture. The sound part was replaced by the simpler 示 (show).

ety.hint: A mouth 亼 talking about things

origin.says: Origin debated: one reading is an upside-down mouth (silent, holding something in), another a lid over a mark. It was borrowed for its sound to mean "now, today".

今.name: now
今.in: 领念令含冷零龄邻怜琴贪铃吟玲伶拎岭捻聆羚黔

ety.hint: Simplified form of 東, the sun 日 rising behind a tree 木

origin.says: Simplified from 東, which in oracle bones draws a sack tied at both ends; it was borrowed for east. The old reading as the sun behind a tree is folk etymology. 东 comes from the cursive form.

ety.hint: wide

origin.says: 广 (building) for the meaning plus 付 (hand over) as the sound: a building where documents and goods were stored, then an official residence or government office.

议.def: to consult, to talk over; to criticize, to discuss

ety.hint: speech

origin.says: Simplified from 議: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 義 (justice) as the sound; 言 became 讠 and 義 became 义: to discuss.

议.name: discuss

感.def: to affect, to move, to touch; to perceive, to sense

ety.hint: Two hearts 心 beating together 咸

origin.says: 咸 (all) as the sound plus 心 (heart) for the meaning: what touches the heart, to feel or be moved. The deeper word origin is unclear.

感.name: feel

ety.hint: A decisive 夬 will 忄; 夬 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 夬 (parting) as the sound: first 'pleased, glad', later 'quick'.

ety.hint: A hand 又 held up against a cliff 厂

origin.says: 又 (hand) on 厂 (cliff, here written 𠂆): a hand pulling or climbing up a slope. From 'pull back' came 'turn over', 'reverse', 'oppose'.

ety.hint: Walking 夂 and talking 口

origin.says: 夂 (a foot) coming down into 口 (an opening): first meant to arrive, enter. The meaning each is a borrowing for the sound.

各.name: each
各.in: 路格客络略落露额洛阁赂胳搁酪烙骆

ety.hint: cliff

origin.says: 厂 (cliff) over a squeezed 泉 (spring), whose 水 (water) became 小: a spring bursting from a cliff, the source of a stream, so origin, original. Later 源 took over 'source'.

Originally 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 厶 (an old form of 以, by means of) as the sound. The simplified form also took over 臺 (raised terrace, from part of 高 high plus 至), 檯 (table) and 颱 (typhoon), so it now means platform.

求.def: to seek; to request, to demand; to beseech, to beg for

origin.says: Originally a drawing of a centipede or crawling insect. The word 'to seek, to beg' was written with it because it sounded the same.

求.name: seek

导.def: to direct, to guide, to lead, to conduct

ety.hint: A hand 寸 pointing the way to someplace 巳

origin.says: From 導: 寸 (hand) for the meaning plus 道 (road) as the sound: to lead someone along the road by hand. The simplified form replaced 道 with 巳 (snake sign).

导.name: guide

origin.says: Simplified from 術 (method): 行 (road) plus 朮 (a grain plant) as the sound, the way of doing things. The simplified form keeps only the sound part 朮, written 术.

ety.hint: observe

origin.says: Originally a drawing of a cross-shaped compass for drawing circles; it was later rebuilt as 夫 (man) + 見 (see), read as a man's view, a standard. 見 became 见. So: compass, rule.

车.def: cart, vehicle; to move in a cart

ety.hint: Simplified form of 車, a cart with two wheels, seen from above

origin.says: Simplified from 車, a drawing of a chariot seen from above: two wheels on an axle with the box in the middle. The simplified form is a cursive shortening of the same drawing.

车.name: cart
车.in: 较军连转轻辑输挥渐载软轮辆库暂轨阵舆辖辈辅裤辉辐晕轰斩轿崭链浑惭轴荤莲辙轧轩辗撵

程.def: process, rules; journey, trip; agenda, schedule

ety.hint: grain

origin.says: 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 呈 (present) as the sound: first a small unit of measure (grain was a standard), then a rule, a stage of a journey or a procedure.

程.name: procedure

觉.def: conscious; to nap, to sleep; to wake up

ety.hint: see

origin.says: 见 (see) for the meaning plus the top of 学 (study) as the sound: to wake up and see clearly, to realize, to feel. Simplified from 覺 with the same shorthand top as 学 and 見 written 见.

觉.name: awaken

请.def: to ask, to request; to invite; please

ety.hint: speech

origin.says: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 青 (blue-green) as the sound: to request, to invite. Simplified from 請, with 言 written 讠.

请.name: invite

ety.hint: wood

origin.says: Traditional 權 is 木 (tree) plus 雚 (heron) as the sound: a kind of tree, borrowed for the weight of a steelyard, so 'to weigh', 'power'. The simplified form puts 又 in place of 雚.

号.def: mark, sign; symbol; number; to call, to cry, to roar

ety.hint: mouth

origin.says: 口 (mouth) plus 丂 (breath let out): to call out, to cry. The traditional 號 added 虎 (tiger, roaring); the simplified form drops the tiger. From calling out came 'name, mark, number'.

号.name: number

ety.hint: unit

origin.says: Debated. Early forms show 日 (sun) over 東 (a tied bag), perhaps measuring grain; one reading takes it as the first form of 糧 (grain). The modern shape reads as 旦 (dawn) over 里 (village) but that is not the build.

ety.hint: A pregnant woman

origin.says: A picture of a person with a swollen belly, perhaps a pregnant woman: the body, the trunk.

ety.hint: Two bird's wings opposed; two people back-to-back

origin.says: A drawing of two wings spread back to back, facing opposite ways: going against, hence 'not, wrong'. The negative use is probably a sound loan.

非.name: opposed wings
非.in: 靠排罪悲啡辈匪诽徘菲靡

ety.hint: mouth

origin.says: A late character: 口 (mouth, marking a spoken particle or sound) plus 巴 as the sound. Made for the sentence-ending particle of suggestion, and later 'bar'.

运.def: to run; ship, transport; fortune, luck

ety.hint: walk

origin.says: Simplified from 運: 辶 (walk, move) for the meaning plus 軍 (army) as the sound. The simplification swapped 軍 for 云 (cloud), a closer sound: to move, transport, and fortune.

运.name: transport

处.def: to reside at, to live in; place, locale; department

ety.hint: To go somewhere 夂 and put down a flag 卜

origin.says: An old form: 夂 (a foot coming) plus 几 (stool): coming to rest on a seat, hence to dwell, a place. The traditional 處 added 虍 (tiger) as the sound; the simplified form drops it and its 几 (stool) became 卜 (divine).

处.name: dwelling place

origin.says: Likely a drawing of the handle of a weapon such as 戈 (dagger-axe), with two side strokes added; borrowed for the word 'must'. It is unrelated to 心 (heart).
A woman 母 (mother) with an ornament or hairpin 𠂉 on her head; it was borrowed for its sound to mean 'each, every'. The top is read as a hairpin or a sprout.

ety.hint: calendar

origin.says: Stands for both 歷 (to pass through, experience) and 曆 (calendar), both built on the sound part 厤 (rows of grain). Simplification cut 厤 to 厂 (cliff) and put in 力 (strength) as a new sound part.

ety.hint: earth

origin.says: 其 (basket) as the sound plus 土 (earth): a foundation of earth, a base.

ety.hint: spear

origin.says: Simplified from 戰: 單 (a forked weapon or hunting tool) as the sound plus 戈 (dagger-axe) for the meaning, fighting. The simplified form swaps 單 for 占 (divine) as the sound.

联.def: ally, associate; to connect, to join

ety.hint: ear

origin.says: Simplified from 聯: 耳 (ear) plus 絲 (silk) strings, earrings joined to the ear, hence to connect. The simple form wrote the right side as 关 (close).

联.name: link up

ety.hint: Someone stepping 止 in front of another person 儿

origin.says: A foot (止, now ⺧) above a person (儿): someone stepping ahead, leading the way, hence first, before.

ety.hint: head

origin.says: Simplified from 領 (頁 became 页): 令 (command) as the sound plus 页 (head) for the meaning: first the neck, then the collar, then to lead.
